describe: The image shows a weathered surface, most likely aged wood or rough bark, with irregular vertical streaks running from top to bottom. Dark brown and near-black areas dominate the upper half, while the lower half is warmer tan and orange-brown with pale flecks. Several darker drip-like stains and a small pale highlight patch sit near the centre-right. The pattern is irregular with no regular repeat. Lighting is low and moody, with medium-high contrast and rough, fibrous detail.
